title: AI/ML Engineer, Trainee Engineer
other_details: Work on real-world AI/ML projects that solve meaningful problems. Apply basic concepts of AI/ML to solve real-world problems. Design, develop and deploy machine learning models. Build and train models using libraries like TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch. Experiment with new ideas and emerging technologies. Work on Deep Learning, Neural Networks and advanced models. Collaborate with a passionate and skilled team. Explore and implement Generative AI (GenAI) techniques and applications. Learn, innovate and grow with us. Analyze data, evaluate model performance and derive insights. Key Skills: AI/ML Basics, TensorFlow / Keras/PyTorch, Deep Learning, GenAI, Data Analysis & Problem Solving.
